notes: Final amendment (Amendment No. 1) reporting results. This amendment does not say what kind of fund the filer is; fund_type interval_or_tender_offer_fund is read from the DRIP-funded, NAV-priced repurchase structure (no ticker printed; CUSIP 30290Y 101), not stated outright. Size: the offer was for up to the LESSER of (i) 9,859,801 Shares and (ii) the greater of two DRIP-proceeds-based share counts, so 9,859,801 is a ceiling; the 5% is of the weighted-average Shares outstanding for calendar 2021, not of current outstanding. Only 1,136,649 Shares were bought, so the DRIP-proceeds limit evidently bound (the filing says tenders 'exceeded the maximum number of Shares the Company offered to purchase' but does not state that maximum as a number). Price 'equal to the net asset value per Share' recorded as 100% of NAV; the NAV date (April 30, 2022) is the day after the April 29, 2022 expiration. The proration factor is stated as approximate ('Approximately 4.7%'). Aggregate purchase price approximately $8,304,448.42. commencement_date is the Offer to Purchase date (the original Schedule TO was also filed March 31, 2022). Conditions and the reason for the tender are not stated in this amendment, so both are null; the DRIP-funded 'previous repurchase date for tender offers' language hints at a periodic programme but does not state it.
